quotes.text: The quality of your answer is a direct result of the quality of your retrieval. If you get the retrieval right, even a basic model will perform well.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the episode's core thesis that retrieval, not the model, decides RAG quality.

quotes.text: A system that only uses vector search will always fail on questions that need calculation while a system that only uses SQL will fail on questions that need semantics.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why an agent needs multiple retrieval tools instead of a single search method.

quotes.text: This ability to decline is what makes the system trustworthy. A system that always gives an answer is a system that eventually gives a wrong answer with total confidence.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable argument for instructing AI agents to admit when the answer is not in the documents.

quotes.text: language models are structurally unreliable at arithmetic, it isn't an occasional glitch. The way a model processes numbers is fundamentally different from how it handles language.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Justifies routing numerical questions to SQL instead of letting the model calculate.

quotes.text: Retrofitting a system is much harder than designing it correctly the first time, and the mistakes people make when they try to fix things later are usually the ones that lead to breach notifications.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Makes the case for compliance by design rather than bolting GDPR on afterwards.

Connecting SharePoint via Graph API and credentials

takeaways: RAG quality depends on retrieval rather than the language model, so invest in OCR quality, agentic chunking and re-ranking before upgrading models.
Combining Microsoft Graph API calls with n8n's SharePoint module, plus a timestamp-based sync, enables reliable dynamic ingestion of new, changed and deleted files.

An agent with vector search, full-document retrieval and SQL tools, hosted on EU infrastructure with Azure OpenAI data zone deployments, answers both semantic and numerical questions in a GDPR-compliant way.
hook: Most companies have SharePoint documents and AI licenses, yet their AI still comes up empty on specific questions because the data is not connected. This episode is for architects and automation builders who want a private, EU-hosted RAG system. It walks through a complete blueprint with SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, n8n, Mistral OCR and pgvector, including GDPR design and the failure modes to plan for.
